targets.authors: Falkenbach, D. M., Howe, J. R., & Falki, M.
targets.title: Using self-esteem to disaggregate psychopathy, narcissism, and aggression.
targets.evidence_quote: The purpose of the present study is to replicate the previous ﬁndings to further conﬁrm the relationship between psychopathy, narcissism, aggression, and self-esteem in a community sample.
targets.outcome_quote: Overall, the current results replicated the previous ﬁndings of Falkenbach et al. (2013).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall verdict governs despite subsequent individual differences.

reasoning: Independent community sample repeats the named published findings. The discussion supplies an explicit overall successful verdict.
